problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign parcels to identical delivery trucks. Parcels:
* Parcel 1: size 67 cubic feet
* Parcel 2: size 59 cubic feet
* Parcel 3: size 52 cubic feet
* Parcel 4: size 66 cubic feet
* Parcel 5: size 38 cubic feet
* Parcel 6: size 66 cubic feet
* Parcel 7: size 47 cubic feet
* Parcel 8: size 50 cubic feet
* Parcel 9: size 31 cubic feet
* Parcel 10: size 55 cubic feet
* Parcel 11: size 60 cubic feet
* Parcel 12: size 63 cubic feet
* Parcel 13: size 38 cubic feet
* Parcel 14: size 32 cubic feet
* Parcel 15: size 35 cubic feet
* Parcel 16: size 66 cubic feet
* Parcel 17: size 52 cubic feet
* Parcel 18: size 53 cubic feet
* Parcel 19: size 30 cubic feet

Each truck can carry up to 100 cubic feet of cargo. Load all parcels using the fewest trucks. Every parcel must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total volume in any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
